channel.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh
channel.description: Verified Bangladesh startup, business and investment news

item.title: Ghana is interested in buying products from Bangladesh, there is more potential in six products including medicine and clothing
item.description: This afternoon, the administrator of FBCCI, the top organization of businessmen. Ghana's High Commissioner Kwasi Abiri-Danso said these things while meeting with Fazlul Haque.

item.title: This time Renata medicine of Bangladesh in the Netherlands market
item.description: According to the company, the first shipment of the drug has been sent to the Netherlands market recently. This has further expanded the market of Renata in the European market.

item.title: Blessings on Halal Earnings: 5 Prophetic Principles for Businessmen
item.description: About the hadith

item.title: Struggle to fulfill her husband's dream, Khadija succeeds in cultivating foreign fruits
item.description: Passion fruit vine at the entrance of the house. Pond on one side, orchard on the other. In the yard there are various trees including litchi, mango, bay leaf, tamarind. There are flowers hanging in the loft.

item.title: A maximum grant of Rs 50 lakh to startups, will be available in three phases
item.description: The government will grant a maximum of Tk 50 lakh to startups based on innovation and technology, for which expatriates can also apply.

item.title: Jensen Huang opened a wealth of two and a half million rupees in five days
item.description: Jensen Huang, the former CEO of Nvidia, has faced a huge financial loss due to controversy over personal relationships and a series of accusations. In the last five days, his wealth has decreased by 20.3 billion dollars or 2 thousand 30 million dollars.

item.title: The biggest fair of local products started on November 22, with products from 400 entrepreneurs
item.description: An opportunity to buy various products including clothes, shoes, bags, jewelry, cosmetics, jute goods, handicrafts, electronics made by domestic entrepreneurs under one roof is coming. On November 22, Agargaon in the capital...

item.title: Two-day exhibition of women entrepreneurs in Gulshan is over
item.description: The two-day 'Her Powerful Story, November Expo 2026' of women entrepreneurs has ended in Dhaka's Gulshan. The exhibition was organized at Suvarnabhumi Foundation's Islam Lodge in Gulshan-1 on November 14 and 15.

item.title: NPLs touching Tk 6 lakh crore: Finance Minister in Parliament
item.description: The amount of defaulted loans in the country's banking sector has increased to more than 5 lakh 97 thousand 154 crores, which is 32.17 percent of the total loans disbursed by banks.

item.title: Fahmida's diary now contains only happy stories
item.description: When the girl came from school, she said, she will return by rickshaw. But I don't even have 10 rupees. The baby boy says, he will eat the banana. I said to my daughter, I have no money. I brought my son home saying that I will buy it from the front. I was upset.

item.title: Businessmen cannot be leaders of trade organizations if there is no business
item.description: If there is no business there will be no trade association membership. That is, someone who does not do business cannot be the leader of a trade organization.

item.title: 511 entrepreneurs received BCIC loans, more than half of them are new
item.description: Bangladesh Small and Cottage Industries Corporation (BCIC) is giving loans of Tk.14 crore 330 thousand to 511 entrepreneurs of cottage, micro, small and medium industries (CMSME) of the country.

item.title: 97 jobs in Agriculture Marketing Department, pay scale starting from 20 thousand
item.description: A notification has been released for direct recruitment in the Directorate of Agriculture Marketing under the Ministry of Agriculture. The organization will hire a total of 97 people in 8 different categories. Interested eligible candidates can apply online.

item.title: Bankers want exemption from VAT registration for opening bank accounts of small entrepreneurs
item.description: The current fiscal year's budget mandated Business Registration Number (BIN), also known as VAT registration, for opening bank accounts of all types of businesses, including small entrepreneurs.

item.title: Starting at 90 thousand, now selling crores of rupees
item.description: Once ran a mobile phone flexiload shop; Entrepreneur Nitai Sarkar bought clothes and bed sheets from the wholesale market and sold them online. At one point, he started making home decor products including bed sheets.

item.title: Do you know how many times the wealth of Elon Musk is the budget of Bangladesh?
item.description: The size of the proposed national budget of Bangladesh for the financial year 2026-27 has been announced as Tk 9 lakh 38 thousand crores. This number is quite large for a developing country like ours.

item.title: Musk will hire Jensen Huang, says it's an honor to hire him
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang isn't having a good time. His situation is complicated after he admits to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, an accused Chinese spy.

item.title: Intensive cultivation of Venami started, more than 80 tons of shrimp were found per hectare
item.description: For the first time in the country, a farm in Cox's Bazar has started cultivation of high-yielding species of Venami shrimp in a very intensive manner. The company recently harvested their farmed shrimp for the first time.

item.title: Masud is making artificial hands and feet for the disabled
item.description: Before becoming an entrepreneur. Masud Kamal has worked in banks and various non-governmental organizations (NGOs) for nearly two decades. In that context, you can learn about the process of making artificial limbs and assistive devices for the disabled.

item.title: I became a successful entrepreneur by making fertilizer from crab shells
item.description: This organic fertilizer called Magiccompost is being used in crop fields, rooftop gardens and shrimp farms. Fertilizer price is 30 rupees per kg. By selling this fertilizer, Aslam Hossain's monthly income is 30 to 50 thousand taka.

item.title: Two friends are making cars after leaving their jobs
item.description: Two friends started business with only 30 lakh taka capital. Masuduzzaman Khan and Rashed Nasser. The company received more than one crore work orders last year.

item.title: 9 industry groups in the billion dollar club, who's on the list
item.description: The fiscal year 2025-26 was not very comfortable for the industrial sector of the country. Factory production has been hampered by fuel shortage, and there has been no significant growth in exports.

item.title: Beco wants to expand business in Bangladesh
item.description: Beco, a subsidiary of Turkey's Koch Group, has pledged to continue investing in expanding production capacity and business expansion in Bangladesh.

item.title: Touhid's products made of pineapple, banana, jute yarn are going to 39 countries
item.description: Entrepreneur Towhid bin Abdus Salam has built six factories to manufacture eco-friendly home furnishing products. 4 thousand 700 workers are working in the company which started with only 14 lakh taka and one worker.

item.title: The story of an engineer becoming a businessman
item.description: He passed from Bangladesh University of Engineering (BUET) in 1977. The subject was Civil Engineering. It was relatively easy to get jobs for engineers then. There were even opportunities to work outside the country.

item.title: Business started with 30 thousand taka, now export is 28 crore taka
item.description: Year 1993 After passing high school, Syed Muhammad Shoaib Hashan was admitted to Chittagong College with Honors in Chemistry. Besides, he started a poultry farm with 500 chickens on the roof of his house in Patharghata. Capital 30 thousand taka.

item.title: Nvidia CEO admits affair with Chinese 'spy', investigation begins
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an extramarital affair with a Chinese female spy suspected of being a US intelligence agency.

item.title: Dolly is a successful entrepreneur who quit her job in a foreign company
item.description: Kya Chin Thay (Dolly) left the post of country director of the world famous American company MGF Sourcing and started the buying house business. The time is November 2019. A few workers are also appointed.

item.title: The government wants to make a Bengali model of AI, talks with four institutions
item.description: The government is planning to create its own model of artificial intelligence (AI) in Bengali. For this, the country wants to build a strong computer and server infrastructure.

item.title: Zahidul returned to the United States and is now a successful agricultural entrepreneur
item.description: After spending almost a century and a half abroad, he returned to the country and established himself as an agricultural entrepreneur. Zahidul Islam. Originally, his venture started with the idea of ​​unadulterated crops, later it took a commercial form.
